## About this page

Saves your look and layout to a file, loads them from one, or puts them back as they started.

#### Why it is there

Setting up a new computer or phone the way you like it takes a while. A settings file carries it over, and you can share one with someone who likes your setup.

#### How it works

The file holds every customization: appearance and themes, icons, the vault list, the sidebar, the editor, the item page, codes, the generator, health checks and keyboard shortcuts. Nothing from your vault is in it.

A file saved on the phone works on the computer, and the other way round. Settings one of them does not have are skipped.

Protection settings never travel in a settings file. Lock timers, clipboard clearing, screenshot blocking, the network switch, the tray and start-up choices, the browser extension's connection, the SSH agent, auto-type, update checks, the quick search shortcut and what widgets may show are left out when you save, and ignored when you import. A file from someone else cannot weaken them.

#### Limits

How long the trash keeps items is saved in the vault itself, so it is not in a settings file either.

What the guide has already shown you, such as the welcome and finished tours, stays on this device.

#### On Android

The file holds every customization: appearance and themes, icons, the vault list, navigation, the editor, the item page, codes, the generator, health checks and keyboard shortcuts. Nothing from your vault is in it.

A file saved on the phone works on the computer, and the other way round. Settings one of them does not have are skipped.

Protection settings never travel in a settings file. Lock timers, locking when the screen goes off, clipboard clearing, screenshot blocking, the network switch, autofill, WM Keyboard and watch access, and what a panic signal does are left out when you save, and ignored when you import. A file from someone else cannot weaken them.

See also [Style and theme](/guide/settings/look/), [Theme](/guide/settings/themes/), [Security](/guide/settings/security/), [Keep deleted items for](/guide/settings/trash/#action-trash-keep).

<a id="action-settings-save-file"></a>

## Save to a file

Saves every customization as a JSON file, wm-pass-settings.json, wherever you choose.

See also [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/), [Import](/guide/settings/file/#action-settings-import).

<a id="action-settings-copy-text"></a>

## Copy as text

Copies the same settings to the clipboard as text, to paste into a message or a note. The text holds no secrets, so the clipboard is not cleared afterwards.

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Send to an app.

Opens the share sheet with the same settings as text, to send to another app or another person.

See also [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/), [Import](/guide/settings/file/#action-settings-import).

<a id="action-settings-import"></a>

## Import

Applies settings from pasted text or from a file, and says how many settings changed.

#### How it works

Paste the text and choose **Import**, or choose **Choose a file** to read a saved one.

Settings this version does not know, and values it cannot use, are skipped. Themes in the file are checked like any theme you import, then added to your own themes, replacing any of yours with the same name.

#### Limits

Protection settings in the file are ignored, whoever made it.

See also [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/), [Theme](/guide/settings/themes/).

<a id="action-settings-reset"></a>

## Reset all customization

Puts every customization back to how it started.

#### How it works

Your own themes stay, and so do protection settings such as lock timers. Nothing in the vault changes.

See also [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/).
